summary: Botanic Gardens visitor car park next to bush, no homes anywhere near.
reasons: No dwellings; gardens and bush around
Large sealed car park, plenty of room
Pin itself is a staff access

best_section.where: Western edge of the big asphalt car park, about 40 m north-east of the pin, below the bush

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the north and west, gardens and planetarium around; the nearest buildings are non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road leads straight in; many marked bays so a van fits fully off the road.
drivers.traffic: Busy with visitors by day; the Mt Coot-tha road is further north.
drivers.convention: Only the car park is mapped, open and free; the pin itself sits at a staff access road beside the Auditorium.

flags: Pin is off: it sits in bush at a staff or service entrance, not a place to stop
Two mapped gates nearby, neither on the only access
Gardens car park may close or be patrolled overnight
sun_shade: Palms and bush shade the west edge; the rest of the car park is open to sun.
